responsibility: Implements HP-UX host hooks for locating and loading precompiled headers at stable virtual addresses. It probes for a likely free address range with mmap, then tries to remap the PCH file there; because fixed MAP_PRIVATE file mappings are unreliable on HP-UX, it falls back to an anonymous mapping followed by manual file reads into memory. The file’s responsibility is host-side PCH address and loading policy specific to HP-UX.
